name: sc009-core-untouched
description: SC-009 / FR-055: a full config run (discovery + hook registration + managed README block) MUST NOT create, modify, or delete any file under .specify/scripts/ or .specify/templates/ — those belong to Spec Kit core and are overwritten on core upgrade. The fixture seeds both directories with sentinel core files; after the config run the post-run tree snapshot must carry them byte-identical on both ports (NFR-1), and a reviewer/CI diff of the snapshot's .specify/scripts and .specify/templates against this fixture must be empty — proving the extension wrote nothing into Spec Kit core's own directories.
